mapper.select:
select u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.fishhub_id, IFNULL(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(u.update_time) * 1000, 1) AS update_time_millis, IFNULL(uc.note_total, 0) as note_total, IFNULL(uc.fans_total, 0) as fans_total from fishhub_user.t_user u left join fishhub_count.t_user_count uc on u.id = uc.user_id where u.`status` = 0 and u.is_deleted = 0
and u.id = #{userId}

select n.id, n.creator_id as creator_id, n.title, n.topic_name as topic, n.type, SUBSTRING_INDEX(n.img_uris, ',', 1) AS cover, n.video_uri as video_uri, DATE_FORMAT(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(n.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time, IFNULL(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(n.update_time) * 1000, 1) AS update_time_millis, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, IFNULL(nc.like_total, 0) as like_total, IFNULL(nc.collect_total, 0) as collect_total, IFNULL(nc.comment_total, 0) as comment_total from fishhub_note.t_note n left join fishhub_user.t_user u on n.creator_id = u.id left join fishhub_count.t_note_count nc on n.id = nc.note_id where n.visible = 0 and n.`status` = 1
and n.id in
#{noteId}
and 1 = 0

select u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.fishhub_id, IFNULL(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(u.update_time) * 1000, 1) AS update_time_millis, IFNULL(uc.note_total, 0) as note_total, IFNULL(uc.fans_total, 0) as fans_total from fishhub_user.t_user u left join fishhub_count.t_user_count uc on u.id = uc.user_id where u.`status` = 0 and u.is_deleted = 0
and u.id in
#{userId}
and 1 = 0
